rationale: T0, T1 and T2 are the first writes into declared zero-init targets (q3, q7, q12), so each can use a 4-T compute-only clean_and. The other seven Toffolis hit targets that were already written (q7, q9, q12, q14, q14, q13, q8), so each uses a 4-T Jones Toffoli with a fresh ancilla and a measurement. That gives 40 T versus the naive 70, with the global pass kept only where it lowers T further; the playbook's plan[TxN] rules use a different format and were not applied.
